title: The Son's veiled saying about the day and hour
english: From a homily by Cyril entitled “On ‘Immediately after the suffering of those days the sun will be darkened, and the moon will not give its light, and the stars will fall from heaven’ (Matthew 24:29); but about that day and hour no one knows.”

But when he says this too, he does not at all mean himself. For he did not add precisely “nor the Son of God,” but says in an unqualified way “nor the son,” so that you understand something like this: the disciples were eager to learn everything with precision, and they were attempting, if I may put it this way, to pry into the very depths of the Lord. But the matter was very much beyond them.

orientation: Cyril opens his homily on Matthew 24:29-36 by explaining that when Christ says no one knows the day or hour, not even the Son, he does not precisely mean the divine Son of God.
